_readme: S740 lane 1 (reads): Copper Mountain College's Kinesiology A.A.-T 43132, a named gap (catalog_renumbered, kb/program_requirements_college/copper_mountain/named_gaps_s739.json): its own page (PDF p.107 of the catalog's reissue of 2026-11-18) prints BIOL 023 and KINE 058A, 54A, 057A, 032A, 039A and 047A where the state's file lists BI 23 and PE 43, 45, 91, 52, 96 and 98, and its filed record's note says the course descriptions name each KINE course as formerly a PE course. This prints each course-description page of the reissue that names one of the seven printed codes or a 'formerly' line for PE or BI, line for line, so a session can cite a course_renumbers pair by the catalog's own words (the title, the units and the former code). One load. No model call, nothing written.

questions.renumbers: For each of BIOL 023 and KINE 058A, 054A, 057A, 032A, 039A and 047A: the course description's title, units and the former code it prints.
